definitions.explanation: The scientific study of matter, energy, and their interactions.
Relating to physical properties or phenomena rather than chemical ones.

notes:
{物理|ぶつり} is commonly short for ⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧ (physics). Also used as a prefix meaning 'physical' (as opposed to chemical, digital, etc.).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{物理|ぶつり}{学|がく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧: physics (academic discipline)
- {物理|ぶつり}⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧: physicist
- ⟦{物理|ぶつり}{的|てき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧: physical (na-adjective)
- {物理|ぶつり}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: physical therapy
- {物理|ぶつり}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: physical phenomenon
- ⟦{原子|げんし}→原子：10118_genshi⟧{物理|ぶつり}⟦{学|がく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧: atomic/nuclear physics

USAGE:
⟦{物理|ぶつり}{的|てき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧ is widely used beyond science: ⟦{物理|ぶつり}{的|てき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧ (physically impossible), ⟦{物理|ぶつり}{的|てき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧な⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (physical distance). It contrasts with ⟦{精神|せいしん}{的|てき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧ (mental) and ⟦{論理|ろんり}{的|てき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧ (logical).
